sor_no.description: the SOR, e.g. SOR26110264726 (Satellite's export: order_no)

customer_code.description: the ship-to store's id (Satellite's export: customer_id)

customer_name.description: the ship-to store's name (Satellite's export: customer_name)

cpo_no.description: the customer's PO number: the Faktur Penjualan's Nomor CPO; a PO or a receipt finds its order by it (Satellite's export: po_number, in the PO file)

total.description: the total as invoiced, with PPN (after any tolakan; 0 before billing) (Satellite's export: inv_grand_total_amount)

so_no.description: Satellite's sales-order number, SG… (Satellite's export: sales_order_no, in the PO file)

vat_pct.description: the PPN rate, e.g. 11.00 (Satellite's export: vat_percentage)

billing_no.description: SAP's billing number, once the order is posted (Satellite's export: sap_bill_doc_no)

cgr_no.description: the goods receipt (CGR) number (Satellite's export: cgr_doc_no)

cgr_date.description: the goods receipt's date (Satellite's export: cgr_doc_date)

status.description: the order's status: INVOICE_GENERATED, CGR, … (Satellite's export: document_status)

loaded_at.description: when this row was written here (set by us)

order_dpp.description: DPP as ordered: what the Faktur Penjualan prints (Satellite's export: subtotal_after_discount_amount)

order_total.description: the total as ordered, with PPN: what the Faktur Penjualan prints (Satellite's export: grand_total_amount)

customer_parent.description: the parent customer id the store is under (Satellite's export: ship_to_parent_customer_id)
